message.content: {"count":4,"rationale":"Blocking vaultRead:collection, codeRepo:collection, shareMount:collection, and dbReplica:collection blocks every parent of the target, so four blocks suffice. Four are also necessary: there are four derivations with disjoint blockable steps, each supported by entry footholds: (1) workstation → kerberoast → backupHost → shareMount; (2) containerHost → configSecret → printServer → codeRepo; (3) mailClient and browserStore → rdpLogin → monitoringHost → dbReplica; (4) dmzWeb and ciRunner → vpnSession, together with sshKey → jumpHost, then serviceAccount → vaultRead. Each derivation independently reaches the target, so at least one step in each must be blocked."}
